title: Rav Huna of Barnish
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At Shabbat 28a, Hyman cites Yuchasin and Dikdukei Soferim for the name Rav Huna of Barnish in connection with an objection to Rav Ashi. Hyman’s own text reads Rava of Barnish.

notes.text: The Barnish occurrence in the supplied Shabbat 25a citation remains unlocated in the returned research. No matching named passage is supplied for it, and no whole-folio or work-wide absence is asserted. The Huna/Rava alternatives remain Hyman’s reported readings.

Hyman’s print (vol. I, pp. 357–358) cites Shabbat 28a. The supplied Hebrew gives 25a. The consulted 28a text has Rava of Barnish both in the objection to Rav Ashi and in the reply that continues into 28b. Dikdukei Soferim (Shabbat, p. 52, note mem) records Ravina of Barnish at the first occurrence and Rav Huna of Barnish at the second in its manuscript column. Yuchasin (1857, p. 126) gives Huna and records Rava as a variant.
